name: Will my homeowner's insurance cover water damage to laminate flooring?

mainEntity.name: Will my homeowner's insurance cover water damage to laminate flooring?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most homeowner's insurance policies cover sudden and accidental water damage, such as a burst pipe or appliance malfunction. However, damage from neglected maintenance, ongoing leaks, or floods (if not covered by a separate flood insurance policy) is typically excluded. Reviewing your specific policy or contacting your insurance provider is the best way to understand your coverage. A professional restorer can help document the damage for claims.
acceptedAnswer.description: Homeowner's insurance usually covers sudden water damage, but not issues from neglect or floods (unless separately insured). Check your policy for specifics.
